business_problem: SLB needed a repeatable way to reduce drilling time and improve rate of penetration (ROP) because drilling performance varied significantly between nearby wells, manual analysis of offset-well behavior was too time consuming at field scale, and driller bias plus limited field-specific guidance could lead to suboptimal performance and higher costs.
solution_summary: SLB built and deploys the Drilling Parameters Recommender through its INNOVATION FACTORI program as a machine-learning workflow for drilling optimization. The implementation ingests multiple upstream data sources: historical well data, offset-well performance records, seismic data, time-series surface drilling parameters such as weight-on-bit, RPM, flow rate and torque, formation-response signals including ROP and shocks and vibrations, plus metadata from daily drilling reports and run summaries. Data scientists clean these datasets, split them into training and validation sets, and iterate on machine-learning algorithms until a model meets success criteria. The trained models are then applied to analyze offset wells and calculate recommended operating boundaries for future wells. Results are served through a customized visualization dashboard that engineering and operations personnel use in the field to make drilling decisions intended to maximize ROP and reduce well construction time.

data_flow: Historical well records, seismic datasets, surface drilling time-series data, formation-response measurements, and report metadata are cleaned and split into training and validation sets. SLB tests machine-learning algorithms on these data, applies the selected model to offset wells, and delivers recommended drilling-parameter operating windows in a visualization dashboard used by engineering and operations teams in the field.

business_outcome: SLB automated large-scale offset-well analysis to give field teams data-backed drilling-parameter roadmaps, helping them make more informed decisions, improve drilling consistency, maximize ROP, reduce drilling time, and avoid cost escalation from suboptimal drilling performance.
